entries.title: Shorter cards for adding a runbook or a panel
entries.body: The card that asks before adding a runbook or a panel from elsewhere now shows a few labeled rows instead of paragraphs: where it comes from, what it reaches, and what each panel reads, uses and can do with your tasks. The exact names, each connection's reason and what a panel keeps are one click away under Full details.

picture.alt: The card asking to add the Studio workflows runbook, with rows for From, Reaches, Turns off and Shows panels, and two panels with one line for each permission
